chapter.title: Health monitoring
chapter.para: Health monitoring detects the errors of the module and of the partitions and recovers from them according to the tables of the configuration. An error has an identifier and arises in a system state; the table gives the action for each pair. The errors are: module post-processing event list, illegal request, application error, partition load error, numeric error, memory violation, deadline missed, hardware fault, power failure, stack overflow, process initialization error, no memory for process data, assertion failure, configuration error, check pool and unhandled interrupt. The system states are: partition operating system initialization (INIT_PARTOS), partition user initialization (INIT_PARTUSER), interrupt handler, module operating system, partition operating system, error handler and user process.

section.para: JetOS shall detect and report as errors, when they happen in a partition: a fault of the memory protection (memory violation), an arithmetic fault (numeric error), an invalid instruction or request (illegal request), a missed deadline, a failure of the loading of the partition, and an unexpected interrupt or exception.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the errors that the hardware and the kernel can detect.

section.para: JetOS shall decide, from the configuration, whether an error in a system state is an error of the module or of the partition.

JetOS shall handle an error of the module at once, by the action that the table of the module gives: ignore it, restart the module (every partition is loaded again and starts in COLD_START mode) or shut it down; shutting down is the action if the table says nothing.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The module level is the last line of recovery.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_ERROR_GET_MODULE_ACTION_01 HLR_ERROR_PERFORM_MODULE_ACTION_01 HLR_ERROR_PROCESS_ERROR_MODULE_02 HLR_ERROR_POK_RAISE_ERROR_BY_PARTITION_01 HLR_KERNEL_POK_KERNEL_RESTART_01 HLR_KERNEL_POK_KERNEL_STOP_01 HLR_PARTITION_FOR_EACH_PARTITION_01 HLR_SCHED_POK_PARTITION_RESET_01

section.para: JetOS shall handle an error of a partition by the action that the table of the partition gives: ignore it, stop the partition (IDLE mode), or restart it in COLD_START or WARM_START mode; stopping is the action if the table says nothing.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The partition level recovers without disturbing the others.

section.para: JetOS shall report a restart of a partition for an error on the console, with the description of the error, and record it as the reason of the start.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The operator and the restarted partition must know why it was restarted.

section.para: JetOS shall, for an error that arises in a process in NORMAL mode of a partition that has an error handler, leave its handling to the error handler, which gets it as the next error to handle.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The application can handle the errors of its processes.

section.para: JetOS shall leave the handling of an error of a partition to the table of the partition when the error does not arise in a process in NORMAL mode or the partition has no error handler.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Without an error handler to take it, the error is handled at the partition level.

section.para: JetOS shall let a partition create one error handler process, which has the highest priority of the partition (above all the priorities that the application can give), and configure its concurrency control, only while the partition is not in NORMAL mode.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The error handler must run before the other processes.

section.para: JetOS shall give the error handler, on request, the next error to handle with its identifier, message, the process concerned and the failed address; a synchronous error of a process first, then a missed deadline, then a deadline out of range.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The handler decides what to do from the details.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_ERROR_ARINC_GET_ERROR_KIND_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_GET_ERROR_DESCRIPTION_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_THREAD_CLEAR_ERROR_BIT_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_THREAD_EMIT_SYNC_ERROR_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_COPY_ERROR_TO_USER_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_POK_ERROR_GET_01 HLR_ERROR_ARINC_ERROR_IGNORE_SYNC_01 HLR_THREAD_POK_THREAD_STOP_02

section.para: JetOS shall let a partition raise an application error with a message and an error of the operating system code of the partition, and report a message of the application on the console with the name of the partition.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the means of the application to use the health monitoring.

section.para: JetOS shall handle the errors that remain when the error handler stops as errors of the partition, through its table.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An error must not be forgotten.

section.para: JetOS shall treat an error that is found in the monitor, the debugger or the idle partition as fatal.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These partitions are parts of the kernel, and nothing is left to recover them.
